title: Mushrooms: Medicine or myth?
questions: What are the main ideas you learned from this episode? Please give a brief summary in your own words.
Why are people attracted to natural remedies even when scientific evidence is limited?
What kind of evidence would convince you that a medicinal mushroom really works?
Should products with weak evidence be allowed to make health-related claims?
Can traditional medicine and modern medical research complement each other?
Would you try a mushroom supplement recommended by friends if your doctor said the evidence was uncertain?
